title: Kane no Tera — Temple of the Evening Bell
description: An irimoya-roofed Buddhist worship hall, a three-storey pagoda with nine-ring sorin, and an open bell pavilion. Vermilion timber, white plaster, charcoal ceramic roofs, gilded ridge ornaments, lattice screens and a seated golden Buddha. Separate stone footings are joined by narrow pilgrim paths.
